rule: For each baseline, choose the threshold τ with the highest completion rate over all calibration scenarios and seeds; ties go to the lower false-arrival rate, then to the lower τ.

completion.definition: Trials with the correct terminal outcome (ARRIVED at the target if present; NOT_FOUND if absent) ÷ all trials (excluding aborted).

far.definition: Trials that ended ARRIVED at a candidate that is not a 3-D potted plant ÷ trials in which at least one non-target candidate was opened (encountered).

ccr.definition: Trials that ended ARRIVED at the 3-D potted plant ÷ trials in which a 3-D potted plant is present.

abstention.definition: Trials that ended UNRESOLVED (an engaged candidate stayed UNCONFIRMED) ÷ trials in which at least one candidate was opened.
